headline: **MLB Daily Recap: August 12, 2026**
article:
The Minnesota Twins secured a thrilling 7-5 victory over the Baltimore Orioles, while the St. Louis Cardinals dominated the Philadelphia Phillies 7-1. The Tampa Bay Rays took down the Athletics 8-4, and the Colorado Rockies secured a 6-4 win over the Arizona Diamondbacks.

Injuries and availability are impacting several teams, with Trevor McDonald being transferred to the 60-day injured list due to a right elbow strain. Other notable injuries include Garrett Whitlock's right elbow inflammation, James Outman's concussion, Endy Rodríguez's left hip inflammation, Jake Bloss's right elbow strain, Riley Greene's right hamstring strain, Kyle Karros's concussion, and José Suarez's right hip strain.

Several trades and roster movements have taken place, including Harold Rivas being traded to the Baltimore Orioles as part of a deal involving the Boston Red Sox. Other notable trades include Jacob Berry being traded to the Kansas City Royals, Seth Johnson being traded to the Athletics, and Brandan Bidois being traded to the Pittsburgh Pirates.

top_news.title: **Twins Take Down Orioles in Thrilling 7-5 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Minnesota Twins secured a 5-7 win over the Baltimore Orioles, handing the Orioles their loss. Dylan Beavers led the Orioles' offense with a home run and three RBIs.

top_news.title: **Cardinals Cruise Past Phillies 7-1**
top_news.summary: The St. Louis Cardinals dominated the Philadelphia Phillies, securing a 7-1 victory. Alec Burleson led the Phillies' offense with 2 hits, 3 RBIs, and 3 at-bats.

top_news.title: **Rays Take Down Athletics 8-4**
top_news.summary: The Tampa Bay Rays secured an 8-4 victory over the Athletics, with Liam Hicks leading the offense. Hicks finished the game with 3 hits, 1 home run, and 3 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Rockies Take Down Diamondbacks 6-4**
top_news.summary: The Colorado Rockies secured a 6-4 victory over the Arizona Diamondbacks, with Brett Sullivan leading the offense with a home run and three RBIs. Gerardo Carrillo impressed in relief, striking out four batters in two scoreless innings.

top_news.title: **Trevor McDonald Shifts to 60-Day IL**
top_news.summary: San Francisco Giants right-handed pitcher Trevor McDonald has been transferred from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to a right elbow strain.

top_news.title: **Rivas Joins Orioles in Trade**
top_news.summary: Harold Rivas has been traded to the Baltimore Orioles as part of a deal involving the Boston Red Sox. The trade is related to the August 3 Adley Rutschman trade.
